question: Raghav starts from Point A and drives 25 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn, drives 19 km, turns right and drives 40 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 30 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 15 km and stops at Point P. How far and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A from Point P in a straight line? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution: Given: Raghav starts from Point A and drives 25 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn, drives 19 km, turns right and drives 40 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 30 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 15 km and stops at Point P.
